```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false

# Revised appendix (CJFAS revision). Data, the thermal index, the final model
# formula and the plotting theme come from R/revision_setup.R; tables and
# figures produced by R/07-R/11 are read from tables/revision/ and
# plots/revision/, so run those scripts first.
# The submitted appendix fragments (analysis/_01_eda.qmd etc.) are no longer
# included.

source(here::here("R", "revision_setup.R"))
library(lme4)
library(splines)
library(emmeans)
library(patchwork)
library(knitr)
library(kableExtra)
emm_options(lmer.df = "asymptotic")
theme_set(theme_mfsr(base_size = 10))

rev_tab  <- function(f) readr::read_csv(here::here("tables", "revision", f), show_col_types = FALSE)
rev_plot <- function(f) here::here("plots", "revision", f)
kbl2 <- function(x, ...) {
  kbl(x, booktabs = TRUE, linesep = "", ...) |>
    kable_styling(font_size = 8)
}
fmt_d <- function(doy) format(fixed_date + doy, "%d %b")

# Final model, refit here for diagnostics (identical to R/09)
d     <- model_data()
ctl   <- lmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa")
final <- lmer(FINAL_FORMULA, d, REML = TRUE, control = ctl)

knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  echo      = FALSE,
  warning   = FALSE,
  message   = FALSE,
  cache     = FALSE,
  fig.align = "center",
  fig.pos   = "H",
  out.extra = ""
)
```
